topic: Lamp broken as an informal test; repeated observations; Muslim news-agency journalist lead
summary: Speaker says a Muslim friend who was a journalist at Middle East News Agency encouraged him to go. Initially he considered shadows/reflections near a lamp and trees. He reports Zeitoun police chief arriving with20–30personnel, saying shadows/imaginings, and a lamp being broken with a stone; the area darkened and the figure carrying Christ appeared clearer. He then says he saw more than/about20appearances over a month and later saw nothing when the Arab Socialist Union organized a tent and ticketed entry.
limits: Unidentified retrospective speaker; journalist and police chief unnamed. Captions checked in Arabic, not audio or original police documentation. The last detail should not be silently omitted. Does not verify suburb-wide power cutoff or20–30officers nightly.

topic: Recorded interview attributed to Bishop Athanasius; precisely described duration
summary: Film presents interviewee as Bishop Athanasius of Beni Suef. Arabic captions say Monday into Tuesday morning30April, then describe second viewing2:45–5:00am, full luminous clothed body, turning west then north and moving hands. Says he reported to the Pope.
limits: Recording date and original broadcast provenance not yet authenticated. The English subtitle mistranslates Monday/Tuesday transition and drops important context. The narrative agrees in substance with existing written committee accounts, so do not count as independent confirmation without tracing source dependence.

topic: Motorcycle light test; no assumption of independent event
summary: Speaker says a non-Christian school friend suggested visiting. Describes12–15observers, old Harley motorcycle, revving to intensify headlamp in an attempt to obscure the form; says form became brighter/clearer.
limits: Speaker identity/date unknown. May be the same headlamp episode known through Haraz or another narration of it; do not count as a second independent controlled test.

topic: Varied specificity of firsthand reports; Islamic-invocation speaker
summary: An interviewee opens with Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim, says he was born in Zeitoun and went daily as a young man, and explicitly limits his claim to repeated light in the dome and flying doves. Later a woman describes head-and-shoulder outline like neon, without facial features, persisting about five minutes and seen again another day.
limits: Islamic invocation alone does not independently establish speaker religion or office. Do not inflate his light report into personally seeing detailed Marian gestures. Not contrary testimony denying detailed figures seen by others.

topic: Large number of brief episodes in one night, a counting-unit issue
summary: Speaker recounts family/neighbors attending, appearances roughly every2–3minutes over about6hours from12:30night to6:30dawn, estimating100or more episodes that night; describes still looking back while leaving toward SinanStreet/GesrElSuez.
limits: Retrospective estimate, no secure night date.100episodes is not100documented nights. Requires clarifying units behind commonly repeated90apparition count. English subtitles incorrectly call night/midnight noon/PM although dawn context is clear.

topic: Veil and clothing moving; bowed to cross
summary: A speaker describes full body above roof/main dome, ascending toward cross, bowing, descending and blessing; veil/clothing moving with the air. Reports about2h15duration and drawing Athanasius attention until he saw it.
limits: Speaker identity and observed date unknown. Caption account, not independently verified3Dgeometry or physical clothing. Avoid attaching prior physician’s identity to this speaker without checking edit.
